title: Never-before-seen footage of a UFO at Area 51

tellings.quote: legendary, never-before-seen footage of a UFO at Area 51.

plain: There is said to be legendary footage, never shown before, of a UFO at Area 51, a secret US Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. Michels announces it himself, without saying where it came from, in an episode built around two days he spent with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft near the site.
